title: Dujiangyan Scenic Area 36653-Dujiangyan (49067677038).jpg
author: xiquinhosilva
description: The Dujiangyan is an ancient irrigation system in Dujiangyan City, Sichuan, China. Originally constructed around 256 BC by the State of Qin as an irrigation and flood control project, it is still in use today. The system's infrastructure develops on the Min River, the longest tributary of the Yangtze.
